events.title: Flight to Goa
events.details: IndiGo 6E-215 from Mumbai, arrives at Dabolim (GOI) at 09:30.

events.title: Check in at Seaside Palms Beach Resort
events.details: Settle into beachfront rooms and relax.

events.title: Fort Aguada
events.details: North Goa cluster — 17th-century Portuguese fortress overlooking Sinquerim Beach. Try traditional Goan fish thali at a local shack.

events.title: Anjuna Beach Sunset & Market
events.details: Sunset views with beachside cafes and live music.

events.title: Basilica of Bom Jesus & Old Goa
events.details: UNESCO World Heritage site with baroque architecture.

events.title: Fontainhas Latin Quarter Walk
events.details: Colorful heritage villas in Panaji. Stop by Cafe Bhonsle for local Goan snacks.

events.title: Mandovi River Evening Cruise
events.details: Scenic 1-hour sunset cruise with Goan folk performances.

events.title: Sahakari Spice Plantation Tour
events.details: Guided botanical walk through tropical spice gardens with authentic Goan buffet lunch.

events.title: Vagator Beach & Chapora Fort
events.details: Panoramic coastal cliffs and evening cafe hopping.

events.title: Check out of Seaside Palms Resort
Panaji City Center & Souvenirs
events.details: Cashew shopping and lunch at Ritz Classic.
